subject.title: fix(sessions): keep Matrix DM session keys case-distinct per peer

question: What durable persisted-key contract should distinguish a native Matrix MXID from an existing `session.identityLinks` canonical label with identical text, including labels beginning with `@`?
rationale: The PR correctly avoids treating linked labels as native MXIDs, but its chosen stripping rule changes previously valid configured identifiers and creates a new collision class; selecting a key encoding or migration policy is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Add explicit identity-link key provenance
options.body: Encode or otherwise preserve linked-label provenance in the session-key contract, with an explicit migration path for any persisted sessions that need a new representation.

options.title: Reject ambiguous labels with migration support
options.body: Define a narrow unsupported-label policy only if Doctor can migrate or surface every affected existing configuration and persisted session before runtime uses it.

options.title: Retain stripping behavior
options.body: Accept that `@person` and `person` share a linked canonical identity and document the resulting upgrade and privacy implications.

recommendation.title: Add explicit identity-link key provenance
recommendation.body: Encode or otherwise preserve linked-label provenance in the session-key contract, with an explicit migration path for any persisted sessions that need a new representation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged session-key registry work is the closest established ownership signal for the persisted-key and alias-compatibility contract.
